context: Tests the When Not to Use boundaries, stopping on a missing schema and gating commits on validation.

checklist.name: Declined the scratch note as out of scope
checklist.description: The agent says a quick note without frontmatter does not need this skill and writes it with simple file creation.

checklist.name: Did not create a structured entry for lunch plans
checklist.description: No templated journal entry is produced for the scratch note.

checklist.name: Declined Confluence publishing
checklist.description: The agent says the skill is for local .md files only and does not publish to Confluence.

checklist.name: Did not post to Confluence
checklist.description: No Confluence page is created by the agent.

checklist.name: Identified the missing schema
checklist.description: The agent notices that troubleshooting.yaml is missing or unreadable.

checklist.name: Stopped instead of guessing structure
checklist.description: The agent stops, reports the error and does not invent a structure for the entry.

checklist.name: Listed the available schemas
checklist.description: The agent lists the template schemas that do exist.

checklist.name: Did not commit without a validated entry
checklist.description: No git commit is made because no entry passed validation.

checklist.name: Commit format known
checklist.description: If a commit message is discussed, it follows `Add journal entry: [Brief Description] (YYYY-MM-DD)`.

checklist.name: Did not load compliance.md up front
checklist.description: The agent does not read compliance.md before any validation has failed.
